overall.reasons: Every frame was opened and compared. The contact darkening works only partly. In L5 sun15 the shadow pool is a little darker and a soft contact shadow appears under the mirror sphere and the sphere bases. But the pool stays lighter and warmer than Unreal's. In L6 and L2 the pool barely moves, and in the sun60 frames it does not move. New artifacts appear in every exterior frame at L2, L5 and L6. The room interior walls get a dither cross-hatch pattern. The spheres and the glowing sphere get black blotches and holes. Both AFTER runs show these and both BEFORE runs do not, so they are not capture noise. The sphere frames also show hard dark blobs under the capsule and mirror sphere, plus grain on the capsule and sphere lower edges. That breaks the criteria for no hard outline, no new noise or speckle, and no change to the lit faces. The gain in pool level is too small and too noisy to offset them.
